record.paper_title: Several Open Problems on Banach Spaces (Castro Urdiales 2014)
record.context_brief: Subspaces of ell_p for p greater than 2
record.original_question: For p > 2, does the classical sequence space ell_p contain continuum many pairwise non-isomorphic subspaces?

artifact.self_contained_problem: For a real number $p>2$, let $\ell_p$ denote the classical Banach space of $p$-summable real sequences $(x_n)_{n\in\mathbb{N}}$ with norm $\|(x_n)\|_p=\left(\sum_{n=1}^\infty |x_n|^p\right)^{1/p}$. Two closed linear subspaces $X,Y\subseteq \ell_p$ are called isomorphic if there exists a bounded linear bijection $T:X\to Y$ with bounded inverse. Determine whether $\ell_p$ contains a family $\{X_\alpha:\alpha\in A\}$ of closed infinite-dimensional subspaces with $|A|=2^{\aleph_0}$ such that $X_\alpha$ and $X_\beta$ are pairwise non-isomorphic for $\alpha\neq\beta$.
artifact.status_search_result: The question of how many mutually non-isomorphic subspaces $\ell_p$ has for $p>2$ (and more generally $p\neq 2$) is a long-standing open problem in Banach space theory. Bourgain–Rosenthal–Schechtman (1981) showed there are uncountably many non-isomorphic complemented subspaces of $L_p$, but the corresponding question for $\ell_p$ subspaces with continuum cardinality remains open according to recent surveys on Banach-space dichotomies and the complemented-subspace problem.

status_evidence.title: Local Banach-space dichotomies and ergodic spaces
status_evidence.snippet: The number of non-isomorphic subspaces of classical Banach spaces, including ell_p, is investigated; certain cases remain open.
status_evidence.claim: The exact number of non-isomorphic subspaces of ell_p for p≠2 is still studied as an open question.

status_evidence.title: A Survey on the Complemented Subspace Problem
status_evidence.snippet: Survey discussing classification of subspaces of ell_p and L_p, noting open problems on isomorphism classes.
status_evidence.claim: Counting isomorphism classes of subspaces of ell_p remains incomplete.
